title: Competitors
text: Step-by-step guides for competitors.

title: Update a competitor's phone number
text: Find a competitor, open their profile, and change their phone number. This guide is for show office staff keeping competitor details current.

title: Update a competitor's phone number
heading: Before you start
text: Sign in as office staff. Make sure Riverbend Show 2026 is the current show.

title: Update a competitor's phone number
heading: Part 1: Find the competitor
text: 1. Search for the competitor On Competitors, type the person's name in Search. 2. Open their profile Click View on the competitor's row.

title: Update a competitor's phone number
heading: Part 2: Change the phone number
text: 3. Edit Profile Click Edit Profile. 4. Change the phone number Replace the number in Phone. 5. Save Changes Click Save Changes. The profile shows the new number.

title: Update a competitor's phone number
heading: Good to know
text: Search Competitors Open their profile Edit Profile Change the phone number and save --- Steps verified against the real app on 2026-10-23.

title: Find unpaid entries
text: Filter the entries list to show only entries that haven't been paid. This guide is for show office staff following up entry fees.

title: Find unpaid entries
heading: Before you start
text: Sign in as office staff. Make sure Riverbend Show 2026 is the current show.

title: Find unpaid entries
heading: Part 1: Filter entries
text: 1. Open Entries Click Entries in the left-hand menu. 2. Choose Unpaid Open Payment Status and choose {{filter.status}}. 3. Apply Filters Click Apply Filters. The list shows only unpaid entries.

title: Find unpaid entries
heading: Good to know
text: Open Entries Choose Unpaid under Payment Status Apply Filters --- Steps verified against the real app on 2026-10-23.
